caption: The drawing depicts a single goblet made of glass, rendered using subtle shades of green and grey. The goblet is centrally positioned on a plain, beige background with no additional objects or decorative elements. The cup has a rounded bowl with a slightly bulbous body, a short stem featuring a small beaded detail near its top, and a wide, flat circular base. The outlines and internal shading of the goblet are done with visible pencil or ink strokes, and the coloring is filled in with light green, conveying a translucent effect typical of glass. The artist’s signature and a small scale are present near the bottom right and left corners, respectively.
title: Salt Cellar
